examples.english: The children like loud music and playing.
examples.transliteration: Al-atfal yuhibboon al-musiqa al-aaliyah wa al-la'ib.

examples.english: The children want a big and fun trip.
examples.transliteration: Al-atfal yuriduna rihlatan kabiratan wa mumti'atan

examples.arabic: فرح الأطفال كثيرًا بتحديد موعد الرحلة إلى الشاطئ الجميل
examples.english: The children were very happy with setting the trip's time to the beautiful beach
examples.transliteration: Fariha al-atfal kathiran bi-tahdid maw'id al-rihlah ila ash-shati' al-jameel

examples.english: The children say: We wrote the homework.

examples.arabic: الاب قال صباح الخير للام والاطفال
examples.english: The father said good morning to the mother and children.
examples.transliteration: Al-ab qala sabah al-khayr lil-umm wal-atfal.
examples.storyTitle: A Family at a Football Match

examples.arabic: كان الاطفال سعداء جدا بالفكرة للذهاب الى البحر.
examples.english: The children were very happy with the idea to go to the sea.
examples.transliteration: Kana al-atfalu su'ada' jiddan bil-fikrati li-l-dhahabi ila al-bahr.
